//go:build fts5

package db

import (
    "fmt"
    "os"
    "path/filepath"
    "testing"

    "github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
    "go.kenn.io/agentsview/internal/money"
)

func TestGenerateUsageCacheV21(t *testing.T) {
    dir := os.Getenv("USAGE_V21_FIXTURE_DIR")
    require.NotEmpty(t, dir)
    path := filepath.Join(dir, "archive.db")
    database, err := Open(t.Context(), path)
    require.NoError(t, err)
    seedJournaledUsage(t, database, "one")
    seedJournaledUsage(t, database, "two")
    seedUsageSnapshotSession(t, database, "earlier", "project-a", "2026-08-10T09:00:00Z", 0, 10, "model-a")
    seedUsageSnapshotSession(t, database, "later", "project-b", "2026-08-10T10:00:00Z", 0, 20, "model-a")
    for _, row := range []struct { id, project, timestamp string; output int }{
        {"no-request-a", "project-a", "2026-08-10T09:00:00Z", 10},
        {"no-request-b", "project-b", "2026-08-10T10:00:00Z", 20},
    } {
        insertSession(t, database, row.id, row.project, func(session *Session) { session.Agent = "claude"; session.StartedAt = &row.timestamp })
        require.NoError(t, database.InsertMessages(t.Context(), []Message{{SessionID: row.id, Ordinal: 0, Role: "assistant", Timestamp: row.timestamp, Model: "model-a", ClaudeMessageID: "no-request-shared", TokenUsage: []byte(fmt.Sprintf(`{"output_tokens":%d}`, row.output))}}))
    }
    seedJournaledUsage(t, database, "event-owner")
    require.NoError(t, database.InsertCursorUsageEvents(t.Context(), []CursorUsageEvent{{OccurredAt: "2026-08-10T11:00:00Z", Model: "cursor-model", InputTokens: 30, DedupKey: "cursor"}}))
    cache := warmJournaledUsage(t, database, UsageFilter{Timezone: "UTC", Breakdowns: true, PairwiseSides: true})
    cachePath := cache.path
    require.NoError(t, database.Close())
    require.NoError(t, os.Rename(cachePath, filepath.Join(dir, "cache.db")))
}

// Run this test at v0.47.0 with USAGE_V21_FIXTURE_DIR set to an empty
// directory, then gzip its archive.db and cache.db as costs-*.db.gz.
func TestGenerateUsageCacheV21Costs(t *testing.T) {
    dir := os.Getenv("USAGE_V21_FIXTURE_DIR")
    require.NotEmpty(t, dir)
    database, err := Open(t.Context(), filepath.Join(dir, "archive.db"))
    require.NoError(t, err)
    started := "2026-08-10T09:00:00Z"
    for _, id := range []string{"recorded-event", "exact-event", "recorded-message", "unpriced-message"} {
        insertSession(t, database, id, "cost-fixture", func(s *Session) { s.Agent = "codex"; s.StartedAt = &started })
    }
    seedJournaledUsage(t, database, "untouched")
    recordedCost, exactCost := money.Money{Microdollars: 7000}, money.Money{Microdollars: 8000}
    require.NoError(t, database.ReplaceSessionUsageEvents(t.Context(), "recorded-event", []UsageEvent{{Source: "session", Model: "test-priced-model", InputTokens: 100, Cost: &recordedCost, CostStatus: "recorded", OccurredAt: started, DedupKey: "recorded"}}))
    require.NoError(t, database.ReplaceSessionUsageEvents(t.Context(), "exact-event", []UsageEvent{{Source: "session", Model: "test-priced-model", InputTokens: 100, Cost: &exactCost, CostStatus: "exact", OccurredAt: started, DedupKey: "exact"}}))
    require.NoError(t, database.InsertMessages(t.Context(), []Message{
        {SessionID: "recorded-message", Ordinal: 0, Role: "assistant", Timestamp: started, Model: "test-priced-model", TokenUsage: []byte(`{"input_tokens":100,"recorded_cost_microdollars":9000}`)},
        {SessionID: "unpriced-message", Ordinal: 0, Role: "assistant", Timestamp: started, Model: "unpriced-cost-model", TokenUsage: []byte(`{"input_tokens":100,"recorded_cost_microdollars":11000}`)},
    }))
    cache := warmJournaledUsage(t, database, UsageFilter{Timezone: "UTC"})
    path := cache.path
    require.NoError(t, database.Close())
    require.NoError(t, os.Rename(path, filepath.Join(dir, "cache.db")))
}
